title: Alpethict's Sitting Totem Pack
description: Adds 3D totem model of a minecraft skin to sit on your arm.
body:
This resource pack changes your Totem of Undying into any 3D Minecraft skin you want, in a sitting position.  
# **IMPORTANT**
**One of these** are required to use the pack:
1.  Entity Texture Features and Entity Model Features mods
2.  Optifine
> **_This pack comes with a placeholder skin._** _To simply change it_;
1. Download or grab your skin file.
2. Rename it to "skin" and copy it.
3. Go into this pack --> assets/minecraft/textures/item.
4. Delete the placeholder skin and paste your skin.
- That's it!
